"Sir, your project is not technically accurate. Using cinematic talking style and AI‑generated visuals doesn’t make the system real.
For example, the cooling demonstration with the soda can has several engineering flaws.
The biggest issue is the pump you used — that small air pump from a blood‑pressure device cannot compress and liquefy any refrigerant.
Even with butane or propane, you need around 2.5 bar at 25°C just to reach the condensation point.
So the system cannot work as shown.
I can say you are a good showman, but the setup is not engineering‑grade."
